summary: docs/scaling.md covers all seven mandated topics: exact pinning (--save-exact, rfc2119@<pinned>), npm test and 2119 check as separate CI gate steps, CODEOWNERS for /specs/ and /.2119/verdicts/, the independent-runner recipe (bot-run review, fresh sessions, committer-identity branch protection), explicit evidence globs over bare [review] for critical requirements, shared_evidence for tests/helpers and tests/fixtures, and check --no-verify policy for untrusted contributions
